title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Agent 365 Business Analytics for AI spend, usage and value
summary: The briefing's roadmap facts, preview behaviour and controls are supported. Clarify that the unpublished licensing concerns a separate app charge, and make the calculator roles unambiguous in the controls note.

claims.claim: Microsoft plans Business Analytics to bring AI spend, usage and value together for investment decisions.
claims.quote: Agent 365 Business Analytics brings AI spend, usage, and value together in one place, helping leaders understand where AI investment is going, what value it’s delivering, and where to invest next.

claims.claim: The planned experience explores costs across services, models, agents and users.
claims.quote: Explore cost across services, models, agents, and users

claims.claim: The planned experience identifies the business use cases AI supports and their value.
claims.quote: understand the business use cases AI supports and the value it creates

claims.claim: The planned experience forecasts future spending.
claims.quote: forecast future spend to make more informed investment decisions.

claims.claim: The roadmap status is In development.
claims.quote: "status": "In development"

claims.claim: The general availability target is December CY2026, not a committed release date.
claims.quote: "targetDate": "December CY2026"

claims.claim: The preview target is November CY2026.
claims.quote: "previewDate": "November CY2026"

claims.claim: Learn already documents Business Analytics as a Frontier preview, providing early access to Microsoft AI innovations.
claims.quote: This feature is part of the Frontier preview program. Frontier connects you directly with Microsoft's latest AI innovations.

claims.claim: The documented preview's availability and capabilities may change.
claims.quote: As these features are still in development, their availability and capabilities might change over time.

claims.claim: Business Analytics is a dedicated app for business decision makers and general managers.
claims.quote: Business Analytics is a dedicated app for business decision makers and general managers (GMs) to view and track the cost and usage of their organization's Microsoft AI services in one place.

claims.claim: The app has Overview, Use cases, Cost & forecast, Users & groups and service-specific pages.
claims.quote: Overview ... Use cases ... Cost & forecast ... Users & groups ... Services pages (Microsoft Copilot, GitHub Copilot, and Agents)

claims.claim: The experience combines licensed Microsoft 365 Copilot with usage-based services including Cowork, agents and GitHub Copilot.
claims.quote: The app supports these scenarios and brings insights for licensed Microsoft 365 Copilot and usage-based AI services, such as Copilot Cowork, agents, and GitHub Copilot, together in a single experience.

claims.claim: Cost & forecast covers usage-based billing and excludes Microsoft Copilot user subscription licence costs.
claims.quote: The Cost & forecast page focuses on usage-based billing. Microsoft Copilot user subscription license costs aren't included.

claims.claim: The Overview service card shows Microsoft 365 Copilot cost as Included in license.
claims.quote: For Microsoft 365 Copilot, cost shows as "Included in license" because it's covered by the per-user license.

claims.claim: Forecast options include base and growth forecasts.
claims.quote:
Base or steady forecast, which assumes future usage is consistent with recent usage.
Growth forecast, which allows recent usage growth to continue in the projection.

claims.claim: What-if analysis can estimate spend-cap and model-mix changes.
claims.quote:
Spend cap: Estimate the impact of applying a monthly spending cap
Model mix: Estimate the impact of shifting usage between models or providers

claims.where: What's changing; Why it matters; Governance controls; rationale: risk
claims.claim: A reporting budget target does not configure a spending policy or enforce a spending limit.
claims.quote: A reporting budget target helps you analyze spending. Creating the target doesn't configure a spending policy or enforce a spending limit.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions; rationale: risk
claims.claim: A scenario changes only the forecast comparison, not live access, model routing, spending policies, budgets or user limits.
claims.quote: A scenario changes only the forecast comparison. It doesn't modify live access, model routing, spending policies, budgets, or user limits.

claims.claim: The cited AI-value methodology describes estimates for Cowork.
claims.quote: This entire article applies to Cowork assisted hours and value, including customization. It does not apply to Copilot assisted hours and Copilot assisted value, including customization.

claims.claim: AI value does not represent realised savings.
claims.quote: AI value is an estimate of the labor value associated with AI's contribution. It doesn't represent realized cost savings, increased revenue, or a guaranteed return on investment.

claims.claim: The app reports cost per user.
claims.quote: Daily cost per user | The average daily cost per user over the selected time period.

claims.claim: Cost analysis can be broken down by group.
claims.quote:
Depending on the data available for your scope, cards can include:
Job function
Model
Service
Organization
Group

claims.claim: Cost analysis can be broken down by model.
claims.quote: The Model tab shows cost and activity by model provider. Expand a provider to see the models included beneath it.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; Why it matters; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft has not stated the app's general-availability arrival mechanics or default state.
claims.quote: Searched: "Agent 365 Business Analytics" "general availability" default GCC "feature". Opened introduction, manage/introduction and Viva feature-access-management; these document preview access, not a GA arrival default.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.model; Cost and licensing; Open questions
claims.claim: A separate app licence or price has not been published; the licensing model remains unknown.
claims.quote: Searched: "Agent 365 Business Analytics" "license" "price" pricing billing. Opened Business Analytics introduction, Copilot Credits billing setup and Agent 365 service description; none specifies a separate Business Analytics licence or price.

claims.claim: Learn states no licence or price, meaning no separately specified licence or price for this app.
claims.quote: Tenant must have at least 50 Copilot licenses assigned.
claims.fix: Replace 'states no licence or price' with 'does not specify a separate app licence or price'. The introduction does state a prerequisite of at least 50 assigned Copilot licences.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; Governance guidance; rationale: cost
claims.claim: The introduction requires at least 50 assigned Copilot licences.
claims.quote: Tenant must have at least 50 Copilot licenses assigned.

claims.claim: Access setup is among the introduction's prerequisites.
claims.quote: Access. Admins can assign access and set up partitions for viewing Business Analytics and its various components using the access management page.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Risk assessment: Change & support; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: Spending policies are required for usage-based services and their cost insights.
claims.quote: Spending policies for usage-based services must be set up for users to use these services and get cost insights.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Cost and licensing; Governance guidance
claims.claim: An administrator must turn billing on in the Microsoft 365 admin center for usage-based service and agent metrics.
claims.quote: The admin must turn on billing in the Microsoft 365 admin center for users to see usage-based services and agents metrics.

claims.claim: Some sections appear only when relevant limit data exists.
claims.quote: The Spending limits section appears only when at least one user limit or spending policy applies to the selected scope.

claims.claim: In the preview, leaders in the top three organisational layers receive tenant-level access automatically.
claims.quote: Access by default | - Leaders in the top three layers of your organization, with tenant-level access

claims.claim: The preview introduction gives managers of teams meeting its stated minimum group size of 10 access to their own organisation.
claims.quote: Managers of teams meeting the minimum group size of 10 can access insights for their own organization, including cost insights.

claims.claim: Global administrators have preview access by default.
claims.quote: Microsoft 365 global admins have access by default.

claims.claim: Insights analysts, Insights admins and leaders or GMs not detected automatically need a Global admin to assign access.
claims.quote:
Access assigned by a Global admin | - Insights analysts
- Insights admins
- Other leaders or GMs who aren't detected automatically

claims.claim: Consumption insights are on by default for GMs.
claims.quote: Consumption insights are on by default for GMs.

claims.claim: Business leaders need an administrator to enable consumption insights before seeing cost insights.
claims.quote: Cost, budget, and usage-based service insights appear only when consumption insights are turned on for your role. Consumption insights are on by default for GMs. For business leaders, an admin must turn them on.

claims.claim: Existing Viva Insights role assignments and their organisational scope carry over.
claims.quote: Users inherit the access and organizational scope of their existing roles from Viva Insights; role assignments don't need to be renewed.

claims.claim: Existing Viva Insights minimum-group-size settings carry over.
claims.quote: existing tenant-level settings such as minimum group size carry over from Viva Insights

claims.claim: Business Analytics > Manage > Access management is the documented entry point for access, export, identification and data-scope controls.
claims.quote: In Business Analytics, on the left, under Manage, select Access management.

claims.claim: Global administrators, AI administrators and Viva Insights administrators can manage access.
claims.quote:
The following admin roles can view and manage access policies, permission sets, and partitions in Business Analytics:
Global administrator
AI administrator
Viva Insights administrator

claims.claim: Access management uses permission sets, partitions and access policies, including Chief Officer, Group Manager and Analyst defaults.
claims.quote: Three access policies: Chief Officer, Group Manager, and Analyst. Each system-defined policy pairs the permission set of the same name with the Global partition.

claims.claim: Administrators control capabilities and whose data a person can see using permission sets and partitions.
claims.quote:
A permission set defines what users can do in the app, such as view dashboards and reports, export data, view identifiable data, customize reports, and publish reports.
A partition defines whose data users can see.

claims.claim: The Identification permission controls named versus de-identified data.
claims.quote: Identification | Whether users can view identifiable data, such as individual names, where your policies allow it. When identification is off, users see de-identified data instead.

claims.claim: The Cost & forecast Users tab shows people with assigned usage limits when the viewer's role permits access.
claims.quote: The Users tab under Spending limits appears when user limits are assigned and your role permits access.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Export is enabled by default, subject to access-management permissions.
claims.quote: Export is only available when it's enabled for employees using access management. It's enabled by default.

claims.claim: Documented export options include CSV download and an MCP connection.
claims.quote:
CSV download: Create and download a file containing the selected service data
MCP connection: View the setup information for making the service data available through an MCP connection

claims.claim: Include user identifiers is off by default.
claims.quote: Because user identifiers are sensitive information, the setting is off by default.

claims.claim: Identifiable exports require permission.
claims.quote: If you don’t have permission to export identifiable information, the setting isn’t displayed and the export uses anonymized identifiers.

claims.claim: Effective access combines valid assignments, and one assignment does not remove access another grants.
claims.quote: the user's effective access is the combination of all of their valid assignments. A capability that's turned on by any assignment is available to the user, and one assignment never removes access that another assignment grants.

claims.claim: Calculator configurations apply tenant-wide.
claims.quote: Calculator configurations apply at the tenant level.

claims.claim: Calculator changes affect dependent metrics and historical trends.
claims.quote: The changes also apply to dependent metrics and historical trends.

claims.claim: Calculator updates appear after the affected data, query or report refreshes.
claims.quote: Changes appear after the affected data, query, or report refreshes.

claims.claim: Completed queries and existing Interactive insights sessions are not recalculated automatically.
claims.quote: Previously completed queries and existing Interactive insights sessions aren't recalculated; rerun or refresh them to use the updated configuration.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Administrators can customise the time and hourly-rate assumptions that affect estimated AI value.
claims.quote: Administrators can customize the estimated time per successful use case and hourly rate. These settings allow organizations to adjust calculations to reflect their own workflows and labor-cost assumptions.

claims.claim: Viva feature access policies are created at Microsoft 365 admin center > Settings > Viva > Settings > Manage feature access > Create a policy.
claims.quote:
From the Microsoft 365 admin center, select Viva from the settings menu.
Select the Settings tab and select Manage feature access.
Select Create a policy.

claims.claim: The printed Add-VivaModuleFeaturePolicy call disables the Viva Insights web app tenant-wide.
claims.quote:
Example: Turn off the Viva Insights web app for all users in your tenant
ModuleId : VivaInsights
FeatureId : Viva Insights web app
Name : DisableFeatureForAll
IsFeatureEnabled : false
Everyone

claims.claim: The Viva Insights web app feature access control supports tenant, group and user scope.
claims.quote: The AI admin can turn the Viva Insights web app on or off at the tenant, group, or user level using the Viva Insights web app feature access management control

claims.claim: Microsoft says the documented Viva feature access controls are unavailable in GCC High and DoD.
claims.quote: The access controls described in this document aren't available in GCC-High or DoD. For GCC (Government Community Cloud), see the documentation for your specific app for availability.

claims.claim: The read documentation does not expressly identify a Business Analytics feature ID or confirm the exact web-app switch as its on/off control.
claims.quote: Searched: "Business Analytics" "Viva Insights web app" FeatureId disable. Opened Business Analytics admin introduction, Viva feature-access-management, manage-access-policies and dashboard settings; applicability is qualified as 'where applicable', with no named Business Analytics ID.

claims.where: controls[2].ui; Why it matters; Cost and licensing; Governance controls
claims.claim: Copilot Credits billing and default spending-policy setup starts at Microsoft 365 admin center > Copilot > Cost Management > Get Started.
claims.quote:
In the Microsoft 365 admin center, go to Copilot and then the Cost Management node.
To unlock AI experiences enabled by usage-based billing, select Get Started.

claims.claim: GET /beta/copilot/costManagement/spendingPolicies lists spending policies in the beta Cost Management API.
claims.quote:
APIs under the `/beta` version are subject to change. Use of these APIs in production applications is not supported.
[List spendingPolicies](spendingpolicy-list) | GET `/copilot/costManagement/spendingPolicies` | Get a list of spending policies.

claims.claim: Creating a spending policy requires Global Administrator or Billing Administrator.
claims.quote: Creating a spending policy also requires the Billing Administrator or Global Administrator directory role at runtime.

claims.claim: Copilot Credits are billed to the subscription selected in the billing method.
claims.quote: Copilot credits are billed to the subscription that you select in the billing method.

claims.claim: Usage automatically continues on pay-as-you-go when that subscription's credits run out.
claims.quote: When credits run out for that subscription, usage automatically continues on a pay-as-you-go basis.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: The app reports Microsoft AI credits and GitHub AI credits separately.
claims.quote: In the credits view, Microsoft AI credits and GitHub AI credits are shown separately.

claims.claim: GitHub page costs are reference information; official GitHub billing and budget setting belong on GitHub.com, not in the Copilot Credits control.
claims.quote: Cost and credit information on this page is for reference only. For official billing and detailed charges for GitHub AI credits and budget setting, go to GitHub.com.

claims.claim: The Cowork value toggle is under Manage > Configurations > Metric calculators > Cowork assisted hours and value > Edit calculator > Value calculator > Value metrics.
claims.quote:
Under Cowork assisted hours and value, select Edit calculator.
Select the Value calculator tab.
On the right, use the Value metrics toggle to turn AI value metrics on or off for your organization.

claims.claim: The Cowork Value metrics display toggle applies tenant-wide and is off by default.
claims.quote: Administrators can control whether AI value metrics for Cowork are displayed to users in their organization. This setting applies across the tenant and is turned off by default.

claims.claim: Viva Insights admins configure Cowork value metrics; Copilot value metrics require Global admin or both Viva Insights admin and Chief officer.
claims.quote: Viva Insights admins can configure Cowork value metrics. Only users who have both Viva Insights admins and Chief officer roles, or who are global admins, can configure Copilot value metrics.
claims.fix: Replace the ambiguous role sentence in controls[3].note and its rendered table note with: 'Viva Insights admins configure Cowork value metrics; Copilot value metrics require both Viva Insights admin and Chief officer roles, or Global admin.' The body already gives this qualification.

claims.claim: Minimum group size is configured under Business Analytics > Manage > Configurations > Privacy > Minimum group size.
claims.quote:
To open the page in Business Analytics, on the left under Manage, select Configurations.
Use the Privacy tab to control how data is scoped, aggregated, classified, suppressed, and included in Advanced Analysis.

claims.claim: Minimum group size must be at least five and hides aggregated insights below the threshold, not unaggregated user-level insights.
claims.quote:
Minimum group size is the minimum number of people that must be in a group before aggregated insights are shown. Enter a value of at least 5.
It doesn't apply to user-level insights that aren't aggregated.

claims.claim: No PowerShell or API is documented for Business Analytics access policies, Cowork calculators or privacy settings at the time of writing.
claims.quote: Searched: "Agent 365 Business Analytics" access Graph PowerShell; "Business Analytics" calculator privacy API PowerShell Microsoft Graph Viva Insights; "a365-business-analytics" "minimum group size" API. Opened access, configurations, VFAM and Exchange policy references.

claims.claim: Get-VivaModuleFeature -ModuleId VivaInsights lists available Viva Insights feature IDs.
claims.quote:
Get-VivaModuleFeature -ModuleId VivaInsights
Find the feature that you'd like to create an access policy for and make note of its featureID.

claims.claim: The Business Analytics admin introduction points to VFAM for turning the app on or off and managing the exclusion list.
claims.quote:
Manage the exclusion list | VFAM
Manage other feature controls: turn the app on or off, publish reports, export data, Copilot assisted value, Copilot Chat in Viva Insights, and delegation | VFAM

claims.claim: Microsoft has not specified how Business Analytics controls operate in the government clouds listed on the roadmap.
claims.quote: Searched: "Agent 365 Business Analytics" "general availability" default GCC "feature". Opened Business Analytics introduction, admin introduction, configurations, access, VFAM and Agent 365 service description; no Business Analytics government-cloud control behaviour was specified.
